page.overview:
Who is Wood Remains?

Wood Remains are character versions of the card "Wood Remains", appearing in the Yu-Gi-Oh! Capsule Monsters anime.

Wood Remains reside at the graveyard in the World of Capsule Monsters.

Wood Remains, along with The Wandering Doomed, surrounded Yami Yugi, Joey Wheeler, Téa Gardner, Tristan Taylor and Solomon Muto, after they arrived at the graveyard. The humans summoned Celtic Guardian, Baby Dragon, Thunder Kid and Happy Lover from their capsules to defend themselves. The first three defeated a number of Wood Remains, while Happy Lover was terrorized by them. The humans were still outnumbered and unable to escape, so they freed more monsters from their capsules, including Flame Swordsman and Dark Witch, who were able to quickly dispose of the remaining Wandering Doomed and Wood Remains.
